subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin-only cross-runtime auth-binding invalidation coordinator, or require all runtime owners to refresh credentials automatically without a global operator surface?
rationale: Current main deliberately separates destructive session reset from runtime-specific auth refresh, and code evidence cannot determine the permanent coordination, authorization, explicit-pin, and active-run semantics.

options.title: Add narrow coordinator
options.body: Invalidate persistent runtime auth bindings across sessions while preserving canonical session state, explicit pins, and deterministic active-run behavior.

options.title: Runtime refresh only
options.body: Require every runtime and provider owner to resolve current credentials on the next turn and add no global operator action.

options.title: Bulk hard reset
options.body: Reuse the existing reset lifecycle across all sessions, accepting transcript rollover and lifecycle side effects.

recommendation.title: Add narrow coordinator
recommendation.body: Invalidate persistent runtime auth bindings across sessions while preserving canonical session state, explicit pins, and deterministic active-run behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Gateway and session lifecycle are the central coordination boundary, and Peter has the strongest recent and historical ownership signal.
